meta_title: FrontyBack CRM — WhatsApp and web form with instant replies
meta_description: Centralize your business inquiries from WhatsApp and your web form, with automatic replies and sales follow-up. Try it free for 7 days.
hero_titulo: Reply to your customers instantly, without being glued to your phone
hero_subtitulo: Bring your WhatsApp and web form inquiries into one board, with automatic replies the moment someone writes to you.
explica_titulo: What is a CRM and how does it work?
explica_texto: FrontyBack brings every WhatsApp and web form inquiry into one place, replies automatically the moment someone writes to you, and organizes each conversation on a board so no customer slips through the cracks.
feature1_desc: WhatsApp and your web form in one board, no jumping between apps.
feature2_desc: Nobody waits: every inquiry gets an instant reply, any time of day.
feature3_desc: Track every sales opportunity at a glance, from new lead to customer.
feature4_desc: No inquiry ever gets deleted - it stays saved even if you cancel the service.
faq1_q: Do I need a card for the free trial?
faq1_a: No. You get 7 full days free without entering any payment info. We only set up payment once you decide to continue.
faq1_q_intl: Do I need a card for the free trial?
faq1_a_intl: Yes: Hotmart asks for a card when you start the trial (that's how Hotmart manages it on their end), but you won't be charged until the trial ends.
faq2_q: What happens if I don't pay after the trial?
faq2_a: Nothing gets cut off overnight. First you enter a 7-day grace period: you keep receiving inquiries, but automatic replies stop. If you still don't pay after that, the service pauses completely - but your data and the inquiries you already received stay saved, and everything turns back on as soon as you pay.
faq2_q_intl: What if I don't want to continue after the trial?
faq2_a_intl: Hotmart automatically charges the card you entered as soon as day 7 ends, unless you cancel before then from your Hotmart purchases panel. If you cancel after you've already been charged, you enter the same 7-day grace period as any other customer.
faq3_q: Is there a minimum commitment or contract to sign?
faq3_a: No. You can cancel whenever you want, no contract or minimum term.
faq4_q: Do I need to change my WhatsApp number?
faq4_a: No, we connect your own WhatsApp Business number. We'll guide you step by step, no technical knowledge needed.
faq5_a: Yes, just message us whenever you want and we'll adjust it.
faq6_q: What's the difference between paying monthly or the full year?
faq6_a: Paying the year upfront gets you 2 months free - same service, cheaper overall.
faq7_q: What happens to my information if I cancel?
faq7_a: Nothing gets deleted. Every inquiry you already received stays available in your account, whether you use it or not.
faq8_q: Saw something you like on another site and want it on yours?
faq8_a: We'll build it and apply it for you. Tell us what you saw and where, and we'll tell you how to add it to your site or your CRM.
